title: Adjacent-duplicate star insertion
prompt:
Between every pair of **adjacent equal characters**, insert `'*'` (the characters themselves stay).

Examples: `"aabb"` → `"a*ab*b"`; `"abc"` → `"abc"`; `""` → `""`.

tests.name: star-inserted output
tests.hint: Seed the output with charAt(0); from i = 1, append '*' before the char when it equals the previous one.
